---
title: "About CriticalQCD"
description: "About CriticalQCD, an independent community-oriented scientific resource tracking the global search for the QCD critical point."
---



CriticalQCD is an independent, community-oriented scientific resource
dedicated to the global search for the QCD critical point.

Its purpose is to organize and connect experimental evidence,
theoretical developments, open questions, methods, challenges,
public resources, and worldwide research efforts.

CriticalQCD does **not** represent any experimental collaboration,
institution, conference, or funding agency.

## Editorial philosophy

CriticalQCD aims to distinguish clearly between:

- established results,
- suggestive evidence,
- unresolved interpretations,
- theoretical predictions,
- preliminary results,
- noncritical explanations,
- and open questions.

Competing scientific interpretations should be represented fairly.

## Maintainer

CriticalQCD was initiated and is maintained by **Debasish Mallick**.

Community suggestions, corrections, and contributions will be welcomed
as the project develops.
